text:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — we need to lock the press embargo windows for the upcoming marketplace listings (H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi). want to confirm SKU mapping + who owns the external handoff to SI/press.
Samir Shah: can we put a tentative window? iirc vendors want a short embargo 48–72h before GA.
Maya Patel: yea tentatively May 6–8 for the H100 wave, May 20–22 for MI300. Gaudi is still TBD from partner side.
Evan Gomez: FYI marketplace listing pipeline needs SKU tags by EOD next tuesday or the release will slip a week.
Li-Wei Chen: who owns SKU mapping? Product will have canonical names but partners want vendor-specific SKUs for press decks.
Maya Patel: @Samir you volunteered to own vendor SKU parity. can you confirm with hw-partner contacts? also we need an SI readiness checklist to attach to the embargo handoff.
Samir Shah: on it. I'll ping Nvidia and AMD contacts today. rough plan:
- collect vendor SKUs
- create mapping spreadsheet (internal)
- provide trimmed table to press ops
Evan Gomez: link me the spreadsheet when ready — I need SKU -> marketplace SKU mapping for CI test vectors.
Samir Shah: creating sheet now. template header:
```
Vendor, Vendor SKU, Redwood SKU, Marketplace SKU, Region availability, Notes
```
Li-Wei Chen: for SI readiness, we need confirmation on certified image tags and kernel/driver versions. SI wants a short runbook for smoke tests.
Dana Ortiz: Marketing will prep embargo copy once we get final SKU list. also need to know if any regions are excluded from the embargo (china/APAC partner limitations).
Maya Patel: action items:
- Samir: vendor SKU mapping by 2026-05-01 17:00 PT
- Li-Wei: SI runbook draft by 2026-05-03
- Evan: marketplace CI mapping + test vectors by 2026-05-04
- Dana: draft embargo copy once Samir shares SKUs
Samir Shah: noted. pinging @Li-Wei and @Evan in partner channel now.
DeployBot: scheduled reminder set for 2026-05-01 16:45 PT to review SKU spreadsheet (creator: Samir Shah)
Evan Gomez: small risk flag — MI300 supply ETA changed; if partner delays, we may need to split the GA into waves. suggest we include fallback phrasing in embargo that allows partial-day GA by SKU.
Maya Patel: good call. include fallback clause: "listings may be staggered by SKU/region; timeline subject to partner supply windows" — ok to include, @Dana?
Dana Ortiz: yes that's safe. we'll keep marketing copy flexible. also coordinating press outreach windows with partner comms team.
Samir Shah: update — vendor PO confirmed Gaudi availability for private preview only; pushing GA date to partner for confirmation.
Maya Patel: thanks. i'll consolidate into a short runbook and post here once the SKU sheet and SI runbook are in place.
Evan Gomez: thanks everyone — will schedule a 20min sync tomorrow if needed.
Maya Patel: sounds good :thumbsup:
